prompt:
# Bounded design catalog research packet

Unknown: which task-specific semantic states, foreground/background pairs and responsive/motion choices are necessary for three small original web presets: dense review console, handheld stock-count form, long-document reader/annotation? Root will author all catalog schema, code and skill. Your role is source collection and interaction pre-processing, not product implementation.

Read /workspace/A111/skills/design-product-experience/references/design-references.md for packet format. Read current specific primary documents, preferably W3C/WAI contrast/use-of-color/focus and MDN reduced-motion/dialog plus relevant platform guidance. Start with Refero Styles as discovery lead only; don't claim viewing a flow from an index or copy assets/third-party code. Limit to 4-6 material sources, record source URLs, exact available version/access time, snapshots+SHA, cited passages, observed vs inferred points, alternatives and adoption rationale. Unknown asset reuse terms => observation only, propose original design. If access fails, preserve response and proceed with sufficient accessible primary evidence rather than endless research.

Produce research.json and report.md: each proposal links concrete source evidence, task/platform, paired token candidates, component/error/loading/empty/conflict states, keyboard/focus, reduced motion, verification hypotheses and limits. No website-account access or external messages. Tokens/cost/provider identity unknown -> null. No native delegation. No edits to skills/core/catalog or shared state, and no reading sibling work. Max two corrective rounds; save all command results including failures.

Write only /workspace/A111/runs/future/versioned_preset_catalog/research/worker. You may author/run benign analysis and validation scripts there; do not modify core, skill, shared TODO/state or historical evidence. Record actual commands/results and all failed attempts, corrections, parent questions, and unavailable measurements (tokens/cost/model-active-time null). Do not spawn/delegate, inspect siblings or query unrelated workers. This is a new task, never execute old native IDs. Before returning, use /workspace/A111/skills/forge-agent-flow/scripts/hostdraft.py reply with your supplied NEW job/request.json to create a separate incomplete draft. Fill final /workspace/A111/runs/future/versioned_preset_catalog/research/worker/reply.json with the actual task result and hashes of final artifacts. Capture check-reply output before returning. Reply preflight is not semantic acceptance; Root will review. At most two corrective rounds; retain first failures. Do not change referenced outputs after final preflight.
